mapper.select: SELECT COUNT (*) FROM SMT_VEHICLE_APPLY SVA WHERE SVA.VEHICLE_ID = #{vehicleId} AND instr(','||SVA.PARK_ID||',', ',' || #{parkId} || ',') <> 0 AND SVA.STATUS != #{status}
SELECT SS.JCHE_NAME FROM SMT_VEHICLE_STAFF SVS INNER JOIN SMT_STAFF SS ON SVS.STAFF_ID = SS. ID GROUP BY SS.JCHE_NAME ORDER BY SS.JCHE_NAME

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SV. ID, SS. NAME, SV.VEHICLE_PLATE, SS.PHONE, SS.DEP_NAME, SV.VEHICLE_TYPE, SV.DRIVER_LICENSE_ID, SV.DRIVINGL_LICENSE_ID, SS.FACE_PIC_ID, SS.SEX, SS.BADGE, SS.CERTNO, SV.VEHICLE_COLOR, SV.VEHICLE_BRAND, SV.VEHICLE_ASCRIPTION, SS.COMP_ID, SS.COMP_NAME, SS.DEP_ID, SV.PARK_ID, SS. ID AS STAFF_ID FROM SMT_VEHICLE SV LEFT JOIN SMT_VEHICLE_STAFF SVS ON SV. ID = SVS.VEHICLE_ID LEFT JOIN SMT_STAFF SS ON SVS.STAFF_ID = SS. ID WHERE SV. ID = #{id} ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT SS. ID, SS. NAME FROM SMT_STAFF SS WHERE SS.DEP_ID = #{depId}
SELECT va.ID,ve.VEHICLE_PLATE,ve.ID as VID FROM SMT_VEHICLE ve JOIN SMT_VEHICLE_APPLY va ON va.VEHICLE_ID = ve.ID WHERE va.AUTHORITY_ID = #{authId} and ve.VEHICLE_ASCRIPTION=#{type} and va.STATUS=1
SELECT va.ID,ve.VEHICLE_PLATE,ve.ID as VID FROM SMT_VEHICLE ve JOIN SMT_VEHICLE_APPLY va ON va.VEHICLE_ID = ve.ID WHERE va.AUTHORITY_ID = #{authId} and va.STATUS=1
